read.thesis: ZEUS Phase 3 failed: ziltivekimab showed no MACE reduction (HR 0.99, CI 0.88–1.11); non-cash impairment in Q3 2026, but 2026 adjusted operating profit outlook unchanged.

triggers.label: ZEUS MACE trial missed
triggers.quote: this did not translate into major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) risk reduction versus placebo

triggers.label: 2026 adj. operating profit outlook unchanged
triggers.quote: The outcome of ZEUS will not impact Novo Nordisk’s previously communicated adjusted operating profit outlook for 2026

guidance.quote: will not impact Novo Nordisk’s previously communicated adjusted operating profit outlook for 2026

red_flags.label: Phase 3 CV outcomes trial failure
red_flags.quote: this did not translate into major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) risk reduction versus placebo in people with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease

red_flags.label: Non-cash impairment Q3 2026
